newsitem.title: USA: U.S. STOCKPILE SELLS 3,852 TONNES LEAD AT 28.69/LB.
newsitem.headline: U.S. STOCKPILE SELLS 3,852 TONNES LEAD AT 28.69/LB.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 3,852 tonnes of lead to four companies at an average price of 28.69 cents a lb.
The lowest winning bidder was Hochschild Partners at 28.45 cents a lb, while the highest winning bidder was Exide Corp at 29.20 cents a lb.
Other winners included East Penn Manufacturing Co and Non-Ferrous Processing Corp.
The LME closing cash price was 27.30 cents a lb.
The next bid opening for lead is Sept 4.
